fit: registered fatigue item in an isolated caffeine capsule trial
assessment: The registry lists fatigue. The original reports daytime somnolence separately and does not give a fatigue-specific difference in its main tables. The identified supplement concerns adverse events and its bytes were not recovered from checked public routes.

fit: five-extract metabolic pilot with pain event terms
assessment: Fourteen overweight men received the blend without a concurrent comparator. Authors mention low back pain and headache without event counts, pain severity, Parkinson population or a cracked-pepper contrast.

fit: apple consumption task and separate rest-tremor measurement
assessment: Clinical motor assessment captured rest tremor before movement. Eight of 63 with measurable peak-dose dyskinesia also had measurable rest tremor. A separate standardized task used a piece of apple. No ingestion effect or raw preparation was confirmed.

fit: reanalysis of an overlapping motor task cohort including apple
assessment: Rest tremor was a predictor and cutting and eating apple was one task in the related cohort series. The model does not compare rest tremor before versus after apple exposure.
